title: Frobenius in $W(E_8)$ for $y^2=x^3+x+D(t)$ over $\mathbb F_q(t)$: ranks, Tate--Shafarevich groups and trace statistics
summary: Let $q$ be a power of a prime $p\ge5$ and let $\mathcal F_5(q)$ be the set of curves $E_D\colon y^2=x^3+x+D(t)$ over $\mathbb F_q(t)$ with $D$ monic of degree $5$ and $4+27D^2$ squarefree. Each $E_D$ is the generic fibre of a rational elliptic surface with Mordell--Weil lattice $E_8$, Frobenius acts on it by some $w_D\in W(E_8)$, and $L(E_D,T)=\det(1-qw_DT)$ (Shioda, Oguiso--Shioda, Ulmer). From known results (Galois descent, Grothendieck's $\mathrm{Sha}\cong\mathrm{Br}$, Artin, Milne, Urabe) one reads off $E_D(\mathbb F_q(t))=E_8^{w_D}$,…
